answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 6512 Country: BN Title: Please Let me know What is the limit of reading Quran in a year any Hadis in sapport? Question: Asslamoalekum wrwb, Please Let me know What is the limit of reading Quran in a year any Hadis in sapport? Answer ID: 6512 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1630/1261=H/1429) It is better to recite the complete Holy Quran once in a week, if it is not possible then in a month, and even if it is not possible then it should be recited in a year twice at least. The schedule of the Companions (Sahab, May Allah be pleased with them) had been different. Some details regarding it have been written by Hadhrat Shaikhul Haidth Maulana Muhammad Zakaria (RH) in his book "Fazail Aamal" (chapter: Fazail Quran). You should read it attentively times and again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
